purpose: A hub of small, independent, per-source session-extraction skills. The bot owns the list, the shared contract, and the update loop; each member skill owns one source and knows how to pull that source's full, traceable session.

naming.rule: One source per functional skill. The artifact word names WHAT is produced (transcript, transcript-archive, diff, map); the source is declared in the skill's frontmatter `source:` field, not in the folder name, so the same artifact type can exist once per source without name collisions.

roles.hub: the bot itself — owns the list and the contract
roles.meta: a process the bot needs to run (creation, verification, publication)

output_contract.jsonl: <title>.jsonl — full machine-readable transcript, one object per message
output_contract.manifest: manifest.json — provenance, byte accounting, explicit gaps[]
output_contract.raw: raw\ — verbatim copies of the source session's own sidecar files

skills.name: mavis-session-transcript-skill
skills.purpose: Extract the FULL transcript of a local MiniMax Code session (every message, thinking block, tool call, and the tool outputs the runtime externalised to disk), with an independent coverage verifier.

Cloud sessions au NU au randuri locale. Interfata: tool-ul nativ `mavis session messages --source cloud`. Se va defini si in sectiunea cloud a MiniMax Code, conform cerintei lui Popy — aici doar planul.

Sesiuni web-based. Interfata probabila: browser (agent-browser / chrome-devtools) cu profilul deja logat. De verificat pe disc.
Orice AI cu sesiune vizibila intr-un browser: capturarea DOM-ului + a traficului de retea, apoi aceeasi forma de output (.md/.jsonl/manifest.json/raw).

update_loop.rule: A skill that is used gets updated. After EVERY extraction the member skill's runs.md gains an entry: the measured success with its numbers, or the error verbatim.
